last_data: ABS 6432 Jun qtr 2026; RBA Oct 2026; policy verified 15 Nov 2026
label: Scenario-based estimate, not a prediction. General information only - not financial advice; does not consider your personal circumstances.
units: $ thousand, median transfer price (ABS Total Value of Dwellings Table 2, unstratified)

method.central: 50% no-real-change + 50% international base-rate (valuation-conditioned, Dallas Fed IHPD) + policy overlay
method.why: Only blend that did not lose to baselines; fundamentals ECM and drift models failed backtests and are NOT used
method.bands: empirical out-of-sample error quantiles pooled over 3 rolling-origin backtests

policy_assumptions: Tax Reform No.1 Act 2026 (assent 26 Jun 2026): negative gearing quarantined for established dwellings acquired after 7:30pm AEST 12 May 2026, from FY2027-28; pre-cut-off holdings grandfathered until sale; new builds exempt.

CGT 50% discount replaced by cost-base indexation + 30% minimum tax for gains accruing from 1 Jul 2027; pre-1 Jul 2027 gains keep 50% via deemed disposal/re-acquisition; new-build investors may choose either.
SMSF: no new residential LRBAs from 10 Aug 2026 (treated as minor).
Tax Reform No.3 Bill 2026 ("Tranche 2", new-dwelling definition s960-590) assumed to PASS substantially as introduced 14 Oct 2026. NOT yet law at retrieval.
Foreign purchase ban on established dwellings to 30 Jun 2029 (assumed to lapse then, no forecast effect modelled).
APRA serviceability buffer 3pp and 20%/6x DTI speed limit unchanged.
5% Deposit Scheme (uncapped since 1 Oct 2025) and Help to Buy continue.
macro_assumptions: Cash rate 4.85% (3 Nov 2026) assumed to peak; scenarios span further +25-50bp (low) to cuts from H2 2027 (high).
CPI assumption for nominal conversion: 3.5% FY2027, 3.0% FY2028, 2.5% thereafter (RBA 2-3% target midpoint) — ASSUMPTION, CPI uncertainty not included in bands.
NOM per 2026-27 Budget: 245k in 2026-27 (stress test halves it).
Housing Accord: target reached ~Dec 2030 per NHSAC Aug 2026 (i.e. missed by Jun 2029).

policy_overlay.new_builds_relative_to_established: +1% to +3% (judgement; no free new-build price series to model)
policy_overlay.basis: JUDGEMENT anchored to NZ 2021-23 evidence (-12.8pp vs AUS/CAN = upper bound, confounded). AU measures are milder (existing stock grandfathered; CGT change also hits shares, so relative effect smaller). Units heavier because investor-owned share is higher.

effects.a_grandfathered_lock_in: reduces established listings -> partially offsets downside (included net)
effects.c_sell_before_1Jul2027: weak incentive (accrued gains preserved by deemed disposal) -> small 2027 listing bulge, inside FY2027 shift
effects.d_fewer_investor_rentals: upward pressure on rents (not a price forecast; flagged for Signals)
effects.e_after_tax_vs_shares_super: CGT change applies to shares too; relative shift driven mainly by negative gearing

rates_plus2pp_sustained.basis: 2022-23 episode: cash +4.25pp -> AUS real -10.3% peak-to-trough, CAN -29.2%, NZ -26.6% (Dallas Fed RHPI); scaled per pp

migration_halved.real_price_impact: -3% to -8% over 3-5y (ASSUMPTION; fundamentals model failed backtest so no validated elasticity)
migration_halved.basis: 2021 border closure: NOM negative yet AUS real prices +20% (stimulus/low rates dominated) — migration alone is not a reliable driver

recession_7pct_unemployment.basis: 1990-92 recession: AUS real house prices ~-4% (Dallas Fed); NZ/CAN 2022-25 show larger falls when combined with high rates

grandfathering_removed_future.basis: NZ removed deductibility on existing stock: -12.8pp vs AUS/CAN 2021Q1-2023Q4

policy_reversed_by_future_govt.real_price_impact: overlay removed: +3% houses / +5% units vs base
policy_reversed_by_future_govt.basis: NZ reversal 2024-25 produced NO rebound (-5.3pp vs peers) -> treat as upside skew only
